name: Ark Of The Covenant
overview: The Ark of the Covenant, crafted from shittim wood and overlaid with gold, was designed with precise dimensions and equipped with gold rings and staves for carrying, as detailed in Exodus 25:10-15. It served as the sacred meeting place where God communicated with His people from above the mercy seat, situated between the cherubim on the ark, symbolizing His presence and covenant relationship with Israel (Exodus 25:22). This holy object not only represented God's glory and strength but also foreshadowed Christ, embodying God's faithful testimony and divine anointing.
